title: A Systematic Benchmark for Evaluating Multimodal Personalized Reasoning of Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.06259v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: People often make decisions by holistically reasoning over heterogeneous forms of personal information. In this paper, we study the relatively underexplored capability of multimodal personalized reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). To this end, we introduce \texttt{MPRBench}, a novel and comprehensive benchmark specifically designed to evaluate personalized reasoning across a wide range of tasks and real-world challenges. \texttt{MPRBench} consists of 12 sub-tasks and additionally supports interpretable analysis of representative error cases. Through extensive experiments, we find that current personalized MLLMs still struggle with personalized reasoning due to several key challenges, including inaccurate recognition of personalized concepts and sensitivity to irrelevant personal information. We hope that MPRBench will stimulate further research on personalized reasoning in MLLMs. Code and data are available at https://

translated_title: 《一个用于评估视觉-语言模型多模态个性化推理能力的系统性基准》
translated_abstract: 人们常常通过对异构形式的个人信息进行整体推理来做出决策。在本文中，我们研究了多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）中一项相对未被充分探索的能力——多模态个性化推理。为此，我们提出了MPRBench，一个新颖且全面的基准，专门设计用于评估跨广泛任务和现实挑战的个性化推理能力。MPRBench包含12个子任务，并额外支持对代表性错误案例的可解释性分析。通过大量实验，我们发现当前的个性化多模态大语言模型在个性化推理方面仍存在困难，主要面临几个关键挑战，包括对个性化概念识别不准确以及对无关个人信息过于敏感。我们希望MPRBench能够激发对多模态大语言模型个性化推理的进一步研究。代码和数据可在https://获取
tldr: 该论文提出了MPRBench——一个包含12个子任务、支持错误案例可解释性分析的系统性基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型的多模态个性化推理能力，并揭示出现有模型在对个性化概念识别不准确和对无关个人信息敏感方面的关键不足。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MPRBench, a systematic benchmark with 12 sub-tasks and interpretable error analysis for evaluating multimodal personalized reasoning in vision-language models, revealing that current personalized MLLMs still struggle with inaccurate recognition of personalized concepts and sensitivity to irrelevant personal information.
